findings.source_quote: Many of these individuals are interacting and fellowshipping so closely with others from various other groups and churches instead of their own home church
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “hushirikiana na kufellowship kwa ukaribu sana” with “hushirikiana kwa ukaribu sana” (or “wana ushirika wa karibu sana”).
findings.translation_quote: Wengi wa watu hawa hushirikiana na kufellowship kwa ukaribu sana na wengine kutoka vikundi na makanisa mengine mbalimbali badala ya kanisa lao la nyumbani
